/// What a file says, owned.
pub struct Facts {
    /// The rule of the call.
    pub rule: String,
    /// The file, relative to the repository.
    pub path: String,
    /// What is partial and why.
    pub message: String,
}

/// What a file says, borrowed from the encoded bytes.
pub struct Note<'a> {
    /// The rule of the call.
    pub rule: &'a str,
    /// The file, relative to the repository.
    pub path: &'a str,
    /// What is partial and why.
    pub message: &'a str,
}

/// What a file says, owned again.
pub struct Copy {
    /// The rule of the call.
    pub rule: String,
    /// The file, relative to the repository.
    pub path: String,
    /// What is partial and why.
    pub message: String,
}
